ModMetaData.name: Iranian Rugs (for VFE - Art)
ModMetaData.author: MythraPS
ModMetaData.description:
Turns Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art's small, large and grand rugs into Iranian hand-knotted and flat-woven rugs, from several of Iran's weaving traditions: city medallions, Herati lattice, prayer rugs, Bakhtiari garden panels, boteh, vase, Heriz, Turkmen guls, Qashqai, Gabbeh, kilim, Baluch and afshan. There are 35 designs (9 small, 12 large, 14 grand), and each rug you build picks one at random.
The colour of the cloth or leather a rug is made from runs through the whole design: the field, and also shades of it in the borders, stripes, medallions and motifs, alongside fixed traditional colours. Names, sizes, costs, beauty and recipes are unchanged.
Requires Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art.
Current version: v1.2.0 v1.2.0: 35 designs (was 17) from more traditions; the material's colour now shows in the patterns, not just the field.
